title: The Shadow
narration: 2019. A glowing orange ring. The shadow of M87*, 6.5 billion times the Sun's mass. This is where space ends. How do we see the invisible?
visual_goal: First-ever black hole image, then zoom into the dark center

title: The Frozen Edge
narration: The event horizon. Escape velocity equals light speed. Time itself slows—to a distant eye, anything falling in appears frozen forever.
visual_goal: Object stretching and freezing at the horizon, time distortion visual
search_queries: black hole event horizon time dilation

title: The Ripple
narration: 2015. Two black holes—36 and 29 solar masses—collided 1.3 billion light-years away. LIGO heard gravity ripple. Space itself rang like a bell.
visual_goal: Gravitational wave animation, two spiraling black holes merging

title: The Infant Giant
narration: 470 million years after the Big Bang. Quasar UHZ1. A supermassive black hole, already billions of Suns. How did it grow so fast? That mystery remains.
visual_goal: Early universe, bright quasar in dark space, distant galaxies

title: The Question
narration: 1916: predicted. 1967: named. 2015: heard. 2019: seen. Each step bends what we know. Tomorrow, the information paradox might break it all. Where does space end?
visual_goal: Timeline of milestones, then final black hole silhouette against stars
